description: Labelled evaluation set for the semantic matcher. Each scenario is one ward + one category (so every pair inside it passes the matcher's hard pre-filters) containing three genuinely different problems, four complaints each, written in deliberately different voices: formal, terse with typos, long and angry, code-mixed Kannada/Hindi-English. Problems in a scenario share locality names on purpose — the adversarial case the seed data cannot produce. Ground truth: two complaints are the same incident iff they describe the same physical fault at the same place, i.e. one repair job. Authored, not field-collected; see docs/matching-evaluation.md for what that does and does not let us conclude.
